hook_candidates.headline: Your competitors' pricing is leaking money
You're wasting hours on price tracking

caption:
Competitor price tracking used to eat hours of your time, and storage costs for screenshots added up. Now, with shot-scraper 1.12’s WebP support, you can take screenshots of competitor pricing pages with 80% smaller file sizes than JPEG/PNG — and it’s free to use.

The key is the --quality flag (default: lossless). For pricing screenshots, this means you’ll store 50% less data while keeping quality high enough to read text.

If you’re tracking a competitor’s pricing page daily, this cuts your storage costs by half. At $0.05 per GB, that’s $0.025 saved per screenshot.

COPY THIS PROMPT:

Take a screenshot of [competitor url] using shot-scraper, save as a WebP file with 80% quality.

--quality 80

Save this for later to make competitor price tracking effortless. Comment 'tracking' below and we’ll share a free template for your competitor list.
